verdict.rationale: kitty's own shell-integration docs state that zsh, fish and bash integration enables jumping to previous prompts in the scrollback, which is the core of this story. The evidence names only backward jumps to prompts, so full coverage is not shown. missing for 10: documented jumping between command marks (not just prompts), documented forward/bidirectional navigation and its keybindings or actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of prompt jumping.

support.subject: As a developer, I can jump between prompts and command marks in my scrollback thanks to shell integration

citations.quote: Shell integration with zsh, fish and bash enables features such as jumping to previous prompts in the scrollback
